observations: Photo 0, 1, 2: A flatbed truck with an orange drilling rig/mast mounted on the back, cab marked 'Nissan Diesel' (photo 0) and 'UD' (photo 2).
Rig has a tall folded mast, hydraulic arms, and coiled hoses, with visible rust and dust on the orange paint and the cab.
Truck is stationary, parked on bare ground next to other heavy equipment (a wheel loader, a forklift) in what looks like a scrapyard/plant yard.
No photo shows the engine running, the mast raised/operating, the compressor working, or any drill rods in action.
A handwritten sign on the windshield reads something like 'BENT/BAD... STEERING?? NO HAND SIGNAL' (photo 0, 2) - meaning unclear, could be a yard note about a defect or an unrelated yard instruction.
License plate is partially visible but numbers are not fully legible in any photo.
Tires, chassis underside, and drilling rods/bits are not clearly shown; only the mast and cab are visible.

claims.evidence: No photo or video shows the engine running, the mast operating, or the rig drilling; all 3 photos show the machine static.
No documentation or additional photos confirm roadworthiness or site-ready status; phrase suggests sold as-is without guarantee.

risks.proof: A video clip of the engine starting and idling

risks.risk: Drilling rig hydraulics/mast may be non-functional (seized, leaking, or broken)
risks.proof: A video of the mast raising, rotating, and the hydraulic arms cycling

risks.risk: Compressor (if fitted) condition unknown, critical for drilling function
risks.proof: Photo/video of compressor unit and a running test

risks.risk: Extensive rust and wear visible on frame and rig may indicate structural weakness
risks.proof: Close-up photos of welds, mast joints, and chassis rails

risks.risk: Unclear windshield note may indicate a known steering defect
risks.proof: Clear photo of the full sign and a statement on its meaning, plus a steering test video
risks.if_unproven: priced as having a steering fault

risks.risk: Tires, drill rods, bits, and other accessories condition/completeness not shown
risks.proof: Photos of tires, drill rod rack, and tool inventory

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running
Video of the mast raising/lowering and rig drilling cycle
Clear photo of the full windshield sign and explanation of its meaning
Photos of tires, chassis underside, and drill rod/tool inventory
response.reason: The item is clearly a used truck-mounted borehole drilling rig on a Nissan Diesel/UD chassis, but no photo or video shows it running or drilling, so it must be priced at worst case as non-operational pending proof.
